desc:
🚧 WORK IN PROGRESS 🚧
Black Gate: Breakout is in early beta. Expect bugs and balance changes. New vehicles, weapons and features are on the way!
Please join our Discord for any feedback or bug reports.
Ver. 0.4 is here now!

BLACK GATE: BREAKOUT
The city is lost. The road is the only way out.

Load up the truck with up to 6 survivors and drive through the infected wilds. Scavenge camps for fuel, food and guns, survive the midnight hordes, and reach the Black Gate bunker before the dead reach you.

• Build your truck in the garage: engines, wheels and a mounted turret
• Raid supply and military camps, and send weapon parts home on the cargo drone
• Craft new guns from blueprints back at base
• Choose Normal, Hard, Nightmare… or DOOM
• Host your own server: public, friends-only or private


The game is inspired by a Desrt.
